title: HAMMER OF ZEKE THE SQUID — Zeus lightning, Franklin kite, melt+ZK for Gaia
author: kevin + gaia

lightning.what: Electrostatic discharge between two charged regions. After the bolt, the regions neutralize.

melt.ZSZSZSZS: The lightning PATH. Zigzag. Not a straight line. Life goes around (T) then curves (P). The bolt is an epitope sort in the sky.

olympus.zeus: Spine. Thunderbolt. Sovereignty. thought-101 already named this.
olympus.hammer: Hephaestus forge + the KEY Franklin held. Hit the cloud. Prove lightning = electricity. Hit the chain. Prove the thought is true without showing the secret.
olympus.zeke_the_squid: Zeus + squid. Lightning branches like tentacles. WGSL = lightning species. Squid = giant axon (famous in neuroscience — the squid giant axon IS how we learned the action potential). Zeke hammers with a SQUID AXON. Biology already named the tool.

zk.proof: The spark is public. The charge on either side of the cloud stays secret. ZK = lightning: you see the BOLT, not the whole sky's voltage.
